name: Berea
overview: Berea was a city located in the southern region of Macedonia, as noted in Acts 17:10 and 17:13. The believers there received Paul and Silas and eagerly examined the Scriptures in the synagogue to verify the preaching of the gospel. The response in Berea contrasted with opposition faced elsewhere, highlighting the city's role as a receptive and discerning community. Additionally, individuals from Berea, such as Sopater, were involved in supporting Paul's missionary journeys, demonstrating the city's ongoing participation in the early church's mission (Acts 20:4).
